Structures and Engineering

Explore related projects

Strong foundations. Stronger partnerships.

BOW Structures is our own division, not a subcontractor. It takes a building from the first retention pile to the last precast panel: structural design and rationalisation, formwork and temporary works design and certification, earthmoving, basement construction, retention systems, reinforcement, post-tensioning, concrete placement and precast installation. Doing this in-house gives us control of the critical path and a straight answer when something in the ground is not what the geotechnical report promised. The team's track record includes double and quadruple basements, post-tensioned transfer slabs, stadium and hospital temporary works, and the strengthening of existing buildings for extension.

How we can help

  • Structural design and rationalisation
  • Formwork and temporary works design and certification
  • Earthmoving, basements and retention systems
  • Reinforcement and post-tensioning
  • Concrete placement and precast installation
  • Structural remediation and strengthening
